metadata.title: fix(bootstrap): rename orphaned resources to fix team and name assignment conflict
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
## 📌 Summary

`bootstrap_resource_assignments` bulk-assigns orphaned resources (NULL `team_id`/`owner_email`/`visibility`) to the platform admin team on startup. It fails with `UniqueViolation` on `uq_team_owner_name_*` constraints when an orphan shares a name with a resource already in the admin team, or when two orphans share the same name.

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps

Closes #3986

1. Deploy with PostgreSQL where resources exist from a pre-multi-tenant migration (NULL `team_id`)
2. Some resources share a name with resources already assigned to the admin team
3. On startup, `bootstrap_resource_assignments` throws `UniqueViolation` and skips the affected resource type entirely

## 🐞 Root Cause

`mcpgateway/bootstrap_db.py` — the orphan-assignment loop set `team_id`/`owner_email` on all orphans in bulk then called `db.commit()`. If any row caused a unique constraint violation on `(team_id, owner_email, name)`, the entire batch for that resource type was silently skipped.

Two conflict sources:
1. Orphan name matches a resource already assigned to the admin team in the DB
2. Two orphans share the same name — the second conflicts after the first is committed

Affects all 6 resource types: `servers`, `tools`, `resources`, `prompts`, `gateways`, `a2a_agents`.

## 💡 Fix Description

Before assigning, issue one query per resource type to fetch all names already taken in the admin team that match any orphan value exactly or as a `value-%` suffixed variant. Track intra-batch claimed names in a `batch_assigned` set (orphans not yet committed are invisible to the DB query). On conflict, parse numeric suffixes from the taken set, compute `max + 1`, and rename to `original-N` before commit. Visibility and ownership are preserved.

## 🧪 Verification

| Check | Command | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Lint suite | `make lint` | |
| Unit tests | `uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_bootstrap_db.py` | ✅ 52 passed |
| Coverage ≥ 80 % | `make coverage` | |
| Manual regression no longer fails | deploy against PG with duplicate-named orphans | |

## 📐 MCP Compliance (if relevant)
- [x] No breaking change to MCP clients

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make autoflake isort black`)
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed

comments.author: gcgoncalves
comments.body: The `_like_safe()` function escapes `LIKE` wildcards, but it may not fully protect against SQL injection if `v` contains SQL special chars beyond `LIKE` wildcards. Use SQLAlchemy's `literal()` or ensure full parameterization.

comments.author: crivetimihai
comments.body:
This is already fully parameterized. SQLAlchemy's `field_col.like(pattern)` generates `column LIKE :param_1` — the pattern string is passed as a bind parameter, never interpolated into the SQL statement. SQL injection through bind parameter values is not possible.

`_like_safe()` escapes LIKE-specific metacharacters (`%`, `_`, `\`) so the **pattern matching** works correctly (e.g., a resource named `tool_v2` matches literally, not as `tool[any char]v2`). It is not an SQL injection defense — SQLAlchemy's parameter binding already provides that.

Using `literal()` here would be redundant since SQLAlchemy already wraps the value as a `BindParameter` internally when passed to `.like()` or `==`.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
Reviewed the conflict detection and suffix-renaming logic, verified the `unique_field` mapping against all 6 DB constraint definitions, and confirmed the algorithm is correct for all edge cases (existing conflicts, intra-batch duplicates, suffix collisions, NULL field values).

The conservative `(team_id, owner_email)` scoping for `existing_taken` is intentional and safe — it may over-rename for Resource/Prompt models but can never miss a real `UniqueViolation`. This is now documented inline.

Added log sanitization for consistency, a branch coverage test, and hoisted `_like_safe`. 53 tests passing, full differential coverage.

LGTM.

commits.message:
fix(bootstrap): rename orphaned resources on team assignment conflict

When bootstrap assigns orphaned resources to the admin team,
UniqueViolation fires on uq_team_owner_name_* constraints if a
resource with the same name already exists in that team.

Fix: pre-query for taken names in the admin team (existing DB rows)
and track intra-batch claims via batch_assigned set. On conflict,
parse numeric suffixes from taken values and rename to original-N
(max suffix + 1) before the bulk commit. Affects all 6 resource
types: servers, tools, resources, prompts, gateways, a2a_agents.

Closes #3986

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
fix(bootstrap): escape SQL wildcards in LIKE pattern and hoist regex compile

- Escape %, _, and \ in resource names before building the existing_taken
  LIKE filter to prevent false positives when names contain SQL wildcard chars
- Pre-compile per-value suffix regexes above the inner loop instead of
  recompiling on each conflicting resource
- Set explicit name attributes on mock objects in test_resource_assignments_success
  to satisfy re.escape() called during suffix_res construction

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
fix(bootstrap): sanitize log messages and add null-field branch test

Sanitize user-controlled values (resource names/URIs) in the
name-conflict warning log using SecurityValidator.sanitize_log_message
for consistency with the existing error handler pattern.

Add test for orphan resources with None unique-field values to cover
the conflict-detection skip branch.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
refactor(bootstrap): hoist _like_safe helper and document gateway_id tradeoff

Move _like_safe() above the resource-type loop to avoid redefinition
on each iteration. Add an inline comment explaining the intentional
omission of gateway_id from the existing_taken query: the conservative
(team_id, owner_email)-only filter may over-rename for Resource/Prompt
models but can never miss a real UniqueViolation — the correct
tradeoff for one-time bootstrap code.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
